verdict.rationale: Sift applies machine learning to the event data you send it and returns 0-100 risk scores, including abuse-specific scores. The model gets smarter with more historical data, and its output feeds Workflows and Review Queues inside the product, so ML-derived signals are surfaced from your data. However, the evidence shows only numeric risk scores consumed largely via API, not explanatory insights or proactive suggestions presented in the product. Missing for 10: in-product AI-generated explanations or insights on why users are risky, AI-driven recommendations or suggested actions, any conversational or generative assistant over your data, and hands-on corroboration of in-UI insight features.
